description: This file defines a React component for a learner detail page in an instructor dashboard. It displays learner information, course progress, assignment status, and includes navigation links. It imports data and hooks from various internal modules and uses JSX to structure the UI.

methods.name: LearnerDetailPage
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the learner detail page, handling data retrieval, conditional rendering, and UI composition.

methods.name: getStatusBadge
methods.description: Helper function that returns a styled badge component based on the learner's status.
